questions.question: In ΔABC, D and E are the midpoints of sides BC and AC, respectively, If AD = 10.8 cm, BE = 14.4 cm and AD and BE intersect at G at a right angle, then the area (in cm²) of ΔABC is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two medians m₁ and m₂ of a triangle intersect at 90°, the area of the triangle is given by the formula:

Area of ΔABC = (2 ÷ 3) × m₁ × m₂

Area = (2 ÷ 3) × 10.8 × 14.4

Area = 2 × 3.6 × 14.4 = 7.2 × 14.4 = 103.68 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 103.68 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Median AD = 10.8 cm, Median BE = 14.4 cm, AD ⊥ BE.

**Formula Used:** Centroid divides medians in 2 : 1 ratio. Area of ΔABC = 3 × Area of ΔGAB.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09ed7353b0a46abdb5440401382ceaf237f0b889a684039c72d8d69edeef74a8.png] 

⇒ G is the centroid of ΔABC.

⇒ AG = (2 ÷ 3) × AD = (2 ÷ 3) × 10.8 = 7.2 cm

⇒ BG = (2 ÷ 3) × BE = (2 ÷ 3) × 14.4 = 9.6 cm

⇒ Since AD ⊥ BE, ∠AGB = 90°.

⇒ Area of ΔGAB = (1 ÷ 2) × AG × BG

⇒ Area of ΔGAB = (1 ÷ 2) × 7.2 × 9.6 = 3.6 × 9.6 = 34.56 cm²

⇒ Total Area of ΔABC = 3 × Area of ΔGAB

⇒ Area of ΔABC = 3 × 34.56 = 103.68 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 103.68 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Centroid Ratio Property

The centroid (G) divides each median into two parts in the ratio 2 : 1 from the vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.

Area and Medians

The three medians of a triangle divide it into six smaller triangles of equal area.

General Area Formula via Medians

If m₁, m₂, and m₃ are medians, Area of ΔABC = (4 ÷ 3) × √[sₘ(sₘ−m₁)(sₘ−m₂)(sₘ−m₃)], where sₘ is the semi-sum of medians.

Orthogonal Medians Relation

If medians AD and BE are perpendicular, then the side lengths satisfy the relation AB² + BC² + CA² related properties, specifically 5c² = a² + b² where c is the side BC.</p

questions.question: Rishu saves x% of her income. If her income increases by 26% and the expenditure increases by 20%, then her savings increase by 50%. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply Alligation between Expenditure and Savings percentage changes.

Expenditure change = 20%, Savings change = 50%, Mean (Income) change = 26%.

Ratio of Exp : Sav = (50 − 26) : (26 − 20) = 24 : 6 = 4 : 1.

Total Income = 4 + 1 = 5 units.

Savings percentage (x) = (Savings / Income) × 100 = (1 / 5) × 100 = 20%.

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income increase = 26%

Expenditure increase = 20%

Savings increase = 50%

Initial Savings = x% of Income

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a591ff113ee6d6b33b24d88b3a0a88fe26aadf44358c0523fa1895fa1070f847.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let original Income = 100

Original Savings = x, Original Expenditure = 100 − x

New Income = 100 + 26% of 100 = 126

New Expenditure = (100 − x) + 20% of (100 − x)

⇒ New Expenditure = 1.20 × (100 − x) = 120 − 1.2x

New Savings = x + 50% of x = 1.5x

Since Income = Expenditure + Savings:

⇒ 126 = (120 − 1.2x) + 1.5x

⇒ 126 = 120 + 0.3x

⇒ 6 = 0.3x

⇒ x = 6 ÷ 0.3

⇒ x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Formula

Income = Expenditure + Savings. Any percentage change in income is the weighted average of percentage changes in expenditure and savings.

Alligation in Percentage Changes

If two components of a sum change by different percentages, the ratio of the components can be found using alligation: (Sav% change − Inc% change) : (Inc% change − Exp% change).

Base Value Concept

When solving percentage increase/decrease problems, assuming the initial total value (like income) as 100 simplifies the linear equations significantly.</p

questions.question: If frac{{45}}{{53}} = (1)/({a + frac{1){{b + (1)/({c - frac{2){5}}}}}}}, where a, b and c are positive integers, then what is the value of (4a - b + 3c)

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Perform repeated inversion (reciprocal) on 45/53 to extract integer parts.

Step 1: 53 ÷ 45 = 1 (rem 8) → a = 1.

Step 2: 45 ÷ 8 = 5 (rem 5) → b = 5.

Step 3: 8 ÷ 5 = c − 2/5 ⇒ 1.6 = c − 0.4 ⇒ c = 2.

Value = 4(1) − 5 + 3(2) = 4 − 5 + 6 = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

Given: 45/53 = 1 / (a + 1 / (b + 1 / (c − 2/5)))

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34046af17066f41e193d80920947306cee48318575aa62f2a17c81fea295d794.png] 

⇒ 45/53 = 1 / (53/45)

⇒ 53/45 = 1 + 8/45 (Comparing with a + ..., a = 1)

⇒ 8/45 = 1 / (45/8)

⇒ 45/8 = 5 + 5/8 (Comparing with b + ..., b = 5)

⇒ 5/8 = 1 / (8/5)

⇒ 8/5 = c − 2/5

⇒ 1.6 = c − 0.4

⇒ c = 1.6 + 0.4 = 2

⇒ We have a = 1, b = 5, c = 2

⇒ Value = 4a − b + 3c = 4(1) − 5 + 3(2)

⇒ Value = 4 − 5 + 6 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Continued Fraction Properties

questions.question: A person divides a certain amount among his three sons in the ratio of 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 5. If he had divided this amount in the ratio of 1/3,1/4,1/5, his son, who had got the lowest share earlier, would get Rs.1,188 more. Find the amount (in Rs).

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio 1 = 3 : 4 : 5 (Sum = 12)

Ratio 2 = 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/5 → 20 : 15 : 12 (Sum = 47)

To compare, equate sums: LCM(12, 47) = 564 units.

Lowest share son (Ratio 1) = 3/12 × 564 = 141 units.

His share (Ratio 2) = 20/47 × 564 = 240 units.

Difference = 240 − 141 = 99 units → ₹1188 ∴ 1 unit = ₹12. Total = 564 × 12 = ₹6768.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6768.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio 1 = 3 : 4 : 5

Ratio 2 = 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/5

Difference in share of the first son = ₹1188

**Formula:**

Individual Share = (Individual Ratio / Sum of Ratios) × Total Amount

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63d5e3725fe598ddaa83c79bc4e93f830149aeec35963beed08d4a45f941ab59.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total amount be T.

⇒ Sum of Ratio 1 = 3 + 4 + 5 = 12

⇒ Initial share of the son with lowest share (3) = (3/12) × T = T/4

⇒ Ratio 2 = 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/5 = 20 : 15 : 12 (by multiplying by LCM 60)

⇒ Sum of Ratio 2 = 20 + 15 + 12 = 47

⇒ New share of the same son = (20/47) × T

⇒ According to the question: (20T / 47) − (T / 4) = 1188

⇒ (80T − 47T) / 188 = 1188

⇒ 33T / 188 = 1188

⇒ T = (1188 × 188) / 33

⇒ T = 36 × 188 = 6768

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6768.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

The inverse ratio of a : b : c is 1/a : 1/b : 1/c, which is used in problems involving speed/time or efficiency/days.

Proportional Division

If an amount A is divided in ratio a : b : c, the shares are [a/(a+b+c)]×A, [b/(a+b+c)]×A, and [c/(a+b+c)]×A.

questions.question: Remi earns a profit of 20% on selling an article at a certain price If she sells the articles for Rs. 8 more, she will gain 30% What is the original cost price of 16 such articles?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in profit percentage = 30% − 20% = 10%

This 10% difference corresponds to the price increase of ₹8.

Cost Price (100%) of 1 article = (8 ÷ 10) × 100 = ₹80

Cost Price of 16 articles = 16 × 80 = ₹1280

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Initial profit = 20%

Final profit = 30%

Increase in Selling Price (SP) = ₹8

Number of articles = 16

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23abf5d6f0363561783772481b0a946de0a4cb5e6a35ea6283b68612abfd0158.png]

⇒ CP of 1 article = ₹80

⇒ CP of 16 articles = 16 × 80

questions.question: In ΔPQR, O is the in-center and ∠R = 42°. Find the measure of ∠QOP.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any triangle, the angle formed at the in-center by two vertices is 90° + half of the third vertex angle.

Formula: ∠QOP = 90° + (∠R ÷ 2)

Given ∠R = 42°

∠QOP = 90° + (42° ÷ 2) = 90° + 21° = 111°

**∴ The correct answer is 111°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** O is the in-center of ΔPQR and ∠R = 42°.

**Formula:** Angle at in-center = 90° + (Opposite Angle ÷ 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f3a4f2a6d1cab7082d0c5cc315bbc05d1572dfb0715c4f97255f4d7ce8ec534.png] 

In ΔPQR, the sum of internal angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R = 180°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 180° − 42° = 138°

The in-center (O) is the intersection of angle bisectors.

⇒ In ΔQOP: ∠QOP + ∠OPQ + ∠OQP = 180°

⇒ ∠QOP + (∠P ÷ 2) + (∠Q ÷ 2) = 180°

⇒ ∠QOP = 180° − [(∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2]

⇒ ∠QOP = 180° − (138° ÷ 2) = 180° − 69°

⇒ ∠QOP = 111°

**∴ The correct answer is 111°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

In-center Property

The in-center is the point of intersection of the internal angle bisectors of a triangle and is equidistant from all sides.

Circumcenter Angle

The angle subtended by a side at the circumcenter is twice the angle at the opposite vertex: ∠QCP = 2 × ∠R.

Orthocenter Angle

The angle subtended at the orthocenter (H) and the opposite vertex angle are supplementary: ∠QHP = 180° − ∠R.

Ex-center Angle

The angle at the ex-center (E) opposite to vertex R is given by: ∠QEP = 90° − (∠R ÷ 2).</p

questions.question: The sum of the presents age of a father and son is 52 years Four years hence, the son's age will be 1/4 that of the father. What will be the ratio of the age of the son and father, 10 years from now?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of ages 4 years hence = 52 + (4 × 2) = 60 years.

Ratio 4 years hence (Son : Father) = 1 : 4.

Total parts = 1 + 4 = 5 parts ⇒ 5 parts = 60 ⇒ 1 part = 12.

Ages 4 years hence: Son = 12 years, Father = 48 years.

Ages 10 years from now (6 years after the 4-year mark): Son = 12 + 6 = 18, Father = 48 + 6 = 54.

Required Ratio = 18 : 54 = 1 : 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of present ages (F + S) = 52 years

Let Son's present age = x years, Father's present age = (52 − x) years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f15fcc5795feac9e7868b08b0a485255a310d17d6e9e91a8777bb6aac8cf823.png] 

**Calculations:**

According to the question, 4 years hence:

⇒ (x + 4) = (1/4) × ((52 − x) + 4)

⇒ 4 × (x + 4) = 56 − x

⇒ 4x + 16 = 56 − x

⇒ 4x + x = 56 − 16

⇒ 5x = 40

⇒ x = 8

Present ages: Son = 8 years, Father = 52 − 8 = 44 years.

Ages 10 years from now:

⇒ Son's age = 8 + 10 = 18 years

⇒ Father's age = 44 + 10 = 54 years

⇒ Required Ratio = 18 : 54 = 1 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Ages Change

If the sum of ages of 'n' people is S, then after 't' years, the new sum will be S + (n × t).

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals remains constant regardless of the number of years that pass.

Ratio and Scaling

If a ratio is given as a : b and the sum is S, then the values are (a / (a+b)) × S and (b / (a+b)) × S.</p

questions.question: ((1)/(costheta)-(1)/(sintheta))+(1)/({cosec) theta-cottheta}-(1)/(sectheta+tantheta)=?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume θ = 45°, so sinθ = 1/√2, cosθ = 1/√2, tanθ = 1, cotθ = 1, secθ = √2, cosecθ = √2.

Substitute in expression: (1/(1/√2) − 1/(1/√2)) + 1/(√2 − 1) − 1/(√2 + 1)

⇒ (√2 − √2) + (√2 + 1) − (√2 − 1) = 0 + 2 = 2.

Check options at 45°: Option (4) sec45° × cosec45° = √2 × √2 = 2.

This matches the value of the expression.

**∴ The correct answer is secθ cosecθ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (1/cosθ − 1/sinθ) + 1/(cosecθ − cotθ) − 1/(secθ + tanθ)

**Formulas:** cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1 and sec²θ − tan²θ = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b69c804964a08a1704c1db501b328dc7c6a7babe91e98361c9420c3acb6197cf.png] 

⇒ Expression = (secθ − cosecθ) + (cosecθ + cotθ) − (secθ − tanθ)

⇒ Expression = secθ − cosecθ + cosecθ + cotθ − secθ + tanθ

⇒ Expression = cotθ + tanθ

⇒ Expression = (cosθ/sinθ) + (sinθ/cosθ)

⇒ Expression = (cos²θ + sin²θ) / (sinθ cosθ)

⇒ Expression = 1 / (sinθ cosθ) = secθ cosecθ

**∴ The correct answer is secθ cosecθ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Conjugates

1/(secθ + tanθ) = secθ − tanθ and 1/(cosecθ − cotθ) = cosecθ + cotθ because their products result in 1.

Pythagorean Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1; 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ; 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

secθ = 1/cosθ, cosecθ = 1/sinθ, tanθ = sinθ/cosθ, and cotθ = cosθ/sinθ.</p

questions.question: A takes 2 hours more than B to cover a distance of 40 km. If A doubles his speed, he takes 1(1)/(2) hours more than B to cover 80 km. To cover a distance of 90 km, how much time will B take travelling at his same speed?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For 40 km, Time difference (A − B) = 2 hours.

For 80 km at 2 × Speed A, A's time is the same as for 40 km at Speed A.

New difference for 80 km: Time A (for 40 km) − Time B (for 80 km) = 1.5 hours.

Difference in B's times for 80 km and 40 km = 2 − 1.5 = 0.5 hours.

B covers the extra 40 km in 0.5 hours ⇒ Speed of B = 40 ÷ 0.5 = 80 kmph.

Time for 90 km = 90 ÷ 80 = 1 1/8 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 1/8 hours.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance 1 = 40 km, Distance 2 = 80 km, Time difference 1 = 2 hours, Time difference 2 = 1.5 hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/008a409c7f47bb6f046eca5b564aeab7022fd1a41b604aabd25947504805ebe4.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let SA and SB be the speeds of A and B respectively.

⇒ Case 1: 40/SA − 40/SB = 2 ... (i)

⇒ Case 2: 80/(2SA) − 80/SB = 1.5

⇒ 40/SA − 80/SB = 1.5 ... (ii)

⇒ From (i), 40/SA = 40/SB + 2

⇒ Substitute this in (ii): (40/SB + 2) − 80/SB = 1.5

⇒ 2 − 1.5 = 80/SB − 40/SB

⇒ 0.5 = 40/SB

⇒ SB = 40 ÷ 0.5 = 80 kmph

⇒ Time taken by B to cover 90 km = 90 ÷ 80

⇒ Time = 9/8 = 1 1/8 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 1/8 hours.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Speed-Distance Formula

questions.question: On selling an article for Rs 123.40, the gain is 20% more than the amount of loss incurred on selling it for Rs.108. If the article is sold for Rs. 120.75, then what is the gain/loss per cent?

Total ratio units (6 + 5) = 11 units ⇒ 1 unit = 15.40 ÷ 11 = 1.40.

Loss = 5 units = 5 × 1.40 = 7 ⇒ CP = 108 + 7 = 115.

New Gain = 120.75 − 115 = 5.75 ⇒ Gain % = (5.75 ÷ 115) × 100 = 5%.

**∴ The correct answer is Gain 5%.**

Profit = SP − CP | Loss = CP − SP | Gain% = (Gain ÷ CP) × 100

⇒ 108 + x = 123.40 − 1.2x

⇒ x + 1.2x = 123.40 − 108

⇒ 2.2x = 15.40

⇒ x = 15.40 ÷ 2.2 = 7.

⇒ CP = 108 + 7 = ₹ 115.

⇒ New Profit = SP₃ − CP = 120.75 − 115 = ₹ 5.75.

⇒ Gain % = (5.75 ÷ 115) × 100 = (575 ÷ 115)% = 5%.

**∴ The correct answer is Gain 5%.**

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 90° AD is the bisector of ∠A meeting BC at D, and DE ⊥ AC at E. If AB = 10 cm and AC = 15 cm, then the length of DE, in cm, is:

In a right-angled ΔABC (at A), the length of the perpendicular DE from the angle bisector AD to a side is given by the side of the square rule.

Length of DE = (AB × AC) ÷ (AB + AC)

DE = (10 × 15) ÷ (10 + 15)

DE = 150 ÷ 25 = 6 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** AB = 10 cm, AC = 15 cm, ∠A = 90°, AD is the bisector of ∠A, and DE ⊥ AC.

**Formula:** In ΔABC, if AD is the angle bisector of ∠A, then ∠BAD = ∠DAC = ∠A/2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cbcc168a696fbeb2938374e19b0bf930c395254de31097a96de5f9f18af99a1.png] 

⇒ Since AD is the bisector of ∠A (90°), ∠DAC = 45°.

⇒ In right-angled ΔADE, ∠AED = 90° and ∠DAE = 45°.

⇒ ∠ADE = 180° − (90° + 45°) = 45°.

⇒ Since ∠DAE = ∠ADE = 45°, ΔADE is an isosceles right triangle, so AE = DE.

⇒ Let DE = AE = x cm. Then CE = AC − AE = 15 − x cm.

⇒ In ΔCDE and ΔCAB, ∠C is common and ∠CED = ∠CAB = 90°.

⇒ ΔCDE ≈ ΔCAB (By AA similarity criterion).

⇒ DE ÷ AB = CE ÷ AC

⇒ x ÷ 10 = (15 − x) ÷ 15

⇒ 15x = 10(15 − x)

⇒ 15x = 150 − 10x

⇒ 25x = 150

⇒ x = 150 ÷ 25 = 6 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Internal Angle Bisector Theorem

The internal bisector of an angle of a triangle divides the opposite side internally in the ratio of the sides containing the angle. BD ÷ DC = AB ÷ AC.

Length of Angle Bisector

In any triangle ABC, the length of the internal angle bisector AD is given by (2bc cos(A/2)) ÷ (b + c).

The radius of the incircle of a right-angled triangle is r = (Perpendicular + Base − Hypotenuse) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: The base of a pyramid is a square of side 10 cm. If its height is 10 cm, then the area (in cm²) of its lateral suface is:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of square base (s) = 10 cm, Height (h) = 10 cm.

Slant height (l) = √(h² + (s/2)²) = √(10² + 5²) = √125 = 5√5 cm.

Lateral Surface Area = 2 × s × l = 2 × 10 × 5√5 = 100√5 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 100√5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Side of square base (s) = 10 cm, Height of pyramid (h) = 10 cm.

**Formula Used:** Lateral Surface Area = 1/2 × Perimeter of base × Slant height (l)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95f552a35e14e4e3dcc9930148c341a3e8ce57178fb1d4682a090e251687d7d1.png] 

⇒ Distance from center of base to midpoint of side = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm.

⇒ Slant height (l) = √(Height² + 5²) = √(10² + 5²)

⇒ l = √(100 + 25) = √125 = 5√5 cm.

⇒ Perimeter of square base = 4 × 10 = 40 cm.

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 1/2 × 40 × 5√5

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 20 × 5√5 = 100√5 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 100√5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The total surface area of a pyramid is the sum of the lateral surface area and the area of the base. TSA = LSA + Base Area.

Volume of a Pyramid

The volume is one-third of the product of the base area and the vertical height. Volume = 1/3 × Base Area × Height.

Slant Edge Formula

The slant edge (e) can be calculated using the slant height (l) and half the side (s/2): e = √(l² + (s/2)²).</p

questions.question: The compound interest on a sum of Rs. 5,500 at 15% p.a. for 2 years, when the interest is compounded every 8 months, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate for 8 months = (15% ÷ 12) × 8 = 10%.

Number of periods in 2 years (24 months) = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 periods.

Effective Compound Interest for 3 periods at 10% = 33.1%.

CI = 33.1% of 5,500 = 0.331 × 5,500 = 1,820.50.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,820.50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 5,500

Rate (R) = 15% p.a.

Time (T) = 2 years = 24 months

Compounding Period = Every 8 months

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bbdf77f74e679e074d7387436952ef31fee53ddbf8587c669932aa9abd27e02.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Effective Rate (r) = (15 ÷ 12) × 8 = 10% per 8-month period.

⇒ Number of periods (n) = 24 months ÷ 8 months = 3.

⇒ Amount (A) = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

⇒ A = 5500 × (1 + 10/100)³

⇒ A = 5500 × (1.1)³

⇒ A = 5500 × 1.331

⇒ A = Rs. 7,320.50

⇒ Compound Interest (CI) = A − P

⇒ CI = 7,320.50 − 5,500

⇒ CI = Rs. 1,820.50

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,820.50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for Compounding

When interest is compounded every 'k' months, the new rate r' = (Annual Rate ÷ 12) × k and new periods n' = (Total months ÷ k).

Effective CI Percentage (Successive %)

For 3 periods at r%, the effective percentage is 3r + (3r²/100) + (r³/10000). For 10%, it is 3(10) + 3(100)/100 + 1000/10000 = 33.1%.

Difference between CI and SI

For 2 periods, CI − SI = P(r/100)². For 3 periods, CI − SI = P(r/100)² × (3 + r/100).</p

questions.question: The curved surface area of a right cylinder is 3696 cm². Its height is three times its radius. What is the capacity (in litres) of the cylinder? (take π =(22)/(7))

Given: CSA = 3696 cm² and h = 3r.

Base Area (πr²) = 3696 ÷ 6 = 616 cm².

πr² = 616 ⇒ (22/7) × r² = 616 ⇒ r² = 196 ⇒ r = 14 cm.

Volume = Base Area × h = 616 × (3 × 14) = 25872 cm³.

Capacity = 25872 ÷ 1000 = 25.872 litres.

**∴ The correct answer is 25.872 litres.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 3696 cm²

Height (h) = 3 × Radius (r)

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cylinder = π × r² × h

1 Litre = 1000 cm³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32942aefab4ddb1b0bfe305697f079d80a2ed7d496abca950cbaaa21a589fe6b.png]

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r × 3r = 3696

⇒ (132/7) × r² = 3696

⇒ r² = (3696 × 7) / 132

⇒ r² = 28 × 7 = 196

⇒ r = √196 = 14 cm

⇒ h = 3 × 14 = 42 cm

⇒ Volume = 22 × 2 × 14 × 42

⇒ Volume = 25872 cm³

⇒ Capacity in litres = 25872 / 1000

⇒ Capacity = 25.872 litres

**∴ The correct answer is 25.872 litres.**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved area and the areas of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

questions.question: The sides BA and DE of a regular pentagon are produced to meet at F. What is a measure of ∠EFA?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Each exterior angle of a regular polygon is given by 360° ÷ n.

For a regular pentagon (n = 5), each exterior angle = 360° ÷ 5 = 72°.

In the triangle FAE formed by extending the sides, the angles at A and E are the exterior angles.

Sum of angles in ΔFAE = 180°, so ∠EFA = 180° − (72° + 72°).

∠EFA = 180° − 144° = 36°.

**∴ The correct answer is 36°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** A regular pentagon ABCDE where sides BA and DE are produced to meet at point F.

**Formula Used:** Interior angle of a regular polygon = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad82071c46317495c18f4616558d762c4f09c6af44e5fec4500e650ea45a5ee4.png] 

⇒ Interior angle of pentagon = [(5 − 2) × 180°] ÷ 5

⇒ Interior angle = (3 × 180°) ÷ 5 = 108°

⇒ ∠BAE = 108° and ∠AED = 108°

⇒ Since BAF and DEF are straight lines:

⇒ ∠FAE = 180° − ∠BAE = 180° − 108° = 72°

⇒ ∠FEA = 180° − ∠AED = 180° − 108° = 72°

⇒ In ΔFAE, ∠EFA + ∠FAE + ∠FEA = 180°

⇒ ∠EFA + 72° + 72° = 180°

⇒ ∠EFA + 144° = 180°

⇒ ∠EFA = 180° − 144° = 36°

**∴ The correct answer is 36°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Regular Polygon Angles

For a regular polygon with n sides, the exterior angle is 360° ÷ n and the interior angle is 180° − (360° ÷ n).

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of the exterior angles of any convex polygon is always 360°, regardless of the number of sides.

Polygon Interior Sum

The sum of all interior angles of a polygon with n sides is given by (n − 2) × 180°.</p

questions.question: The height of a solid cylinder is 30 cm and the diameter of its base is 10 cm. Two identical conical holes each of radius 5 cm and height 12 cm are drilled out. What is the surface area (in cm²) of the remaining solid?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area of remaining solid = Curved Surface Area of Cylinder + 2 × Curved Surface Area of Cone

Slant height of cone (l) = √(5² + 12²) = √(25 + 144) = 13 cm

Remaining Area = (2 × π × 5 × 30) + 2 × (π × 5 × 13)

Remaining Area = 300π + 130π = 430π

**∴ The correct answer is 430π cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of cylinder (h꜀) = 30 cm

Diameter of cylinder = 10 cm → Radius (r) = 5 cm

Radius of conical holes (r) = 5 cm

Height of conical holes (hₖ) = 12 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caf26f9e0d16fb103cb58f39482493a62e0b82d9c34b2a35d0157d450c11d734.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cylinder = 2πrh

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cone = πrl

Slant height of cone (l) = √(r² + h²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Slant height of cone (l) = √(5² + 12²)

⇒ l = √(25 + 144) = √169 = 13 cm

⇒ CSA of Cylinder = 2 × π × 5 × 30 = 300π cm²

⇒ CSA of one cone = π × 5 × 13 = 65π cm²

⇒ Since holes are drilled out from both bases, original base areas are replaced by conical internal surfaces.

⇒ Total Surface Area = CSA of Cylinder + 2 × (CSA of Cone)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 300π + 2 × 65π

⇒ Total Surface Area = 300π + 130π = 430π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 430π cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Properties

Volume = πr²h | Total Surface Area = 2πr(h + r) | CSA = 2πrh.

Cone Properties

Volume = (1/3)πr²h | Slant height l = √(r² + h²) | CSA = πrl.

Combined Solids Rule

When a cavity is removed, Volume decreases (Vₜₒₜₐₗ − Vᵣₑₘₒvₑd) but Surface Area often increases as new internal surfaces are exposed.</p

questions.question: Given that ΔDEF ~ ΔABC. If the area of ΔABC is 9 cm² and area of ΔDEF is 12cm² , BC = 2.1 cm, then the length of EF is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For similar triangles, the ratio of areas is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Area(ΔDEF) ÷ Area(ΔABC) = (EF ÷ BC)²

12 ÷ 9 = (EF ÷ 2.1)² ⇒ 4 ÷ 3 = (EF ÷ 2.1)²

Taking square root: EF ÷ 2.1 = 2 ÷ √3 ⇒ EF = 4.2 ÷ √3 = (4.2 × √3) ÷ 3 = 1.4√3 cm.

Since 1.4 = 7/5, EF = 7√3/5 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 7√3/5 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Area of ΔABC = 9 cm², Area of ΔDEF = 12 cm², Side BC = 2.1 cm.

**Formula Used:** Ratio of areas of two similar triangles = (Ratio of corresponding sides)².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cea2a50eb663f0e1261ab5e701059de21e5a99948b14fc0cfd3b99f38a69d83.png] 

⇒ Area(ΔDEF) ÷ Area(ΔABC) = (EF ÷ BC)²

⇒ 12 ÷ 9 = (EF ÷ 2.1)²

⇒ 4 ÷ 3 = (EF ÷ 2.1)²

⇒ EF ÷ 2.1 = √(4 ÷ 3) = 2 ÷ √3

⇒ EF = (2.1 × 2) ÷ √3 = 4.2 ÷ √3

⇒ EF = (4.2 ÷ √3) × (√3 ÷ √3) = 4.2√3 ÷ 3

⇒ EF = 1.4 × √3 = (14 ÷ 10) × √3 = 7√3 ÷ 5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 7√3/5 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio of Perimeters

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides: P₁ ÷ P₂ = s₁ ÷ s₂.

Ratio of Medians and Altitudes

For similar triangles, the ratio of corresponding medians, altitudes, and angle bisectors is also equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT)

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides, then the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.</p

questions.question: If a + b + c = 6, a³ + b³ + c³ - 3 abc = 342,and a² + b² + c² = 50, then what is the value of ab + bc + ca?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the basic algebraic expansion: (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

Substitute the given values: 6² = 50 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

36 = 50 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

2(ab + bc + ca) = 36 − 50 = −14

ab + bc + ca = −14 ÷ 2 = −7

**∴ The correct answer is - 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: a + b + c = 6, a² + b² + c² = 50, and a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 342

Formula Used: a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − (ab + bc + ca))

⇒ 342 = 6 × (50 − (ab + bc + ca))

⇒ 342 ÷ 6 = 50 − (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 57 = 50 − (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 50 − 57

⇒ ab + bc + ca = −7

**∴ The correct answer is - 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

The identity is a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca). It is also written as ½(a + b + c)[(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²].

Zero Sum Property

If a + b + c = 0, then the expression a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc becomes zero, which implies a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Square of a Trinomial

The square of the sum of three terms is (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca).</p

questions.question: If 3x² - 5x + 1 = 0, then the value of (x²+(1)/(9x²)) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Divide the equation 3x² − 5x + 1 = 0 by 3x to get x + 1/3x = 5/3.

Square both sides: (x + 1/3x)² = (5/3)².

Apply the identity: x² + 1/9x² + 2 × (1/3) = 25/9.

Subtract 2/3 from both sides: x² + 1/9x² = 25/9 − 6/9 = 19/9.

**∴ The correct answer is 19/9.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

3x² − 5x + 1 = 0

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3x² + 1 = 5x

⇒ (3x² + 1) ÷ 3x = 5x ÷ 3x

⇒ (3x² ÷ 3x) + (1 ÷ 3x) = 5/3

⇒ x + 1/3x = 5/3

⇒ Squaring both sides: (x + 1/3x)² = (5/3)²

⇒ x² + (1/3x)² + 2 × x × (1/3x) = 25/9

⇒ x² + 1/9x² + 2/3 = 25/9

⇒ x² + 1/9x² = 25/9 − 2/3

⇒ x² + 1/9x² = (25 − 6) ÷ 9

⇒ x² + 1/9x² = 19/9

**∴ The correct answer is 19/9.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Expansion

The identity (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab is essential for solving problems involving sums of squares of reciprocal terms.

Reciprocal Property

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2. This is a common shortcut used in competitive exams.

Generalized Reciprocal Case

If ax + 1/bx = k, then (ax)² + 1/(bx)² = k² − 2 × (a/b). This formula allows direct calculation without full squaring.</p

Volume of a Solid Sphere

questions.question: Two positive numbers differ by 1280. When the greater number is divided by the smaller number, the quotient is 7 and the remainder is 50. The greater number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference between numbers = 1280

From division rule: Greater − Smaller = 1280

Given: Greater = 7 × Smaller + 50

Substitute: (7 × Smaller + 50) − Smaller = 1280 ⇒ 6 × Smaller = 1230

Smaller number = 1230 ÷ 6 = 205

Greater number = 205 + 1280 = 1485

**∴ The correct answer is 1485.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference (D) = 1280

Quotient (Q) = 7

Remainder (R) = 50

**Formula Used:**

Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b389e64ac134315ee8430d060da2eeaced6ce8df930fa48c412318d5dff8b7c.png] 

Let the smaller number be y and the greater number be x.

⇒ x − y = 1280 --- (1)

⇒ x = 7y + 50 --- (2)

Substitute the value of x from equation (2) into equation (1):

⇒ (7y + 50) − y = 1280

⇒ 6y + 50 = 1280

⇒ 6y = 1280 − 50

⇒ 6y = 1230

⇒ y = 1230 ÷ 6

⇒ y = 205

Substitute y = 205 in equation (1) to find x:

⇒ x − 205 = 1280

⇒ x = 1280 + 205

⇒ x = 1485

**∴ The correct answer is 1485.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division Algorithm

It states that for any two positive integers a and b, there exist unique integers q and r such that a = bq + r, where 0 ≤ r < b.

Remainder Property

The remainder in any division is always non-negative and strictly less than the divisor. If the remainder is 0, the dividend is exactly divisible by the divisor.

Linear Equations in Two Variables

A system of two linear equations like x − y = k₁ and x = my + k₂ can be solved efficiently using the substitution or elimination method.</p

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 15 days. B is 25% more efficient than A and C is 40% more efficient than B. A and C work together for 3 days and then C leaves. A and B together will complete the remaining work in:

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠C = 90°, Point P and Q are on the sides AC and BC, respectively, such that AP : PC = BQ : QC = 1 : 2 then, (AQ²+BP²)/(AB²) is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Assume lengths $AC = 3$ and $BC = 3$ for simplicity.

Given $AP : PC = 1 : 2$, then $PC = 2$ and $AC = 3$.

Given $BQ : QC = 1 : 2$, then $QC = 2$ and $BC = 3$.

By Pythagoras, $AQ² = 3² + 2² = 13$ and $BP² = 3² + 2² = 13$.

Also, $AB² = 3² + 3² = 18$.

Ratio $(AQ² + BP²) ÷ AB² = (13 + 13) ÷ 18 = 26 ÷ 18 = 13/9$.

**∴ The correct answer is 13/9.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In ΔABC, ∠C = 90°

AP : PC = 1 : 2 ⇒ AC = 3x, PC = 2x

BQ : QC = 1 : 2 ⇒ BC = 3y, QC = 2y

**Formula Used:**

Pythagoras Theorem: Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc90886f90bf560279c8d49c1f453eea8c8e6eb71737284ea20ea5c531bd347.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In right-angled ΔAQC: AQ² = AC² + QC²

⇒ AQ² = (3x)² + (2y)² = 9x² + 4y² --- (i)

⇒ In right-angled ΔBPC: BP² = BC² + PC²

⇒ BP² = (3y)² + (2x)² = 9y² + 4x² --- (ii)

⇒ Adding (i) and (ii): AQ² + BP² = 9x² + 4y² + 9y² + 4x²

⇒ AQ² + BP² = 13x² + 13y² = 13(x² + y²) --- (iii)

⇒ In right-angled ΔABC: AB² = AC² + BC²

⇒ AB² = (3x)² + (3y)² = 9x² + 9y² = 9(x² + y²) --- (iv)

⇒ Dividing (iii) by (iv): (AQ² + BP²) ÷ AB² = [13(x² + y²)] ÷ [9(x² + y²)]

⇒ (AQ² + BP²) ÷ AB² = 13/9

**∴ The correct answer is 13/9.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pythagoras Theorem

In any right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: H² = P² + B².

Median Property in Right Triangle

If AD and BE are medians of ΔABC (right angled at C), then 4(AD² + BE²) = 5AB².

Apollonius Theorem

For any triangle ABC and median AD: AB² + AC² = 2(AD² + BD²).</p

questions.question: The marked price of an article is 40% above its cost price. If its selling price is 73 (1)/(2)\% of the marked price, then the profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Cost Price (CP) of the article be 100 units.

Marked Price (MP) = 140% of 100 = 140 units.

Selling Price (SP) = 73.5% of 140 = 0.735 × 140 = 102.9 units.

Profit % = SP − CP = 102.9 − 100 = 2.9%.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.9%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Markup percentage = 40% above CP

Selling Price (SP) = 73 1/2% of MP = 73.5% of MP

**Formula Used:**

MP = CP × (100 + Markup%)/100

SP = MP × (SP percentage of MP)/100

Profit % = [(SP − CP) / CP] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae249b1629e342e7d129cb67872d05f71331a0069b58f0f513fa9e310f96e613.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 + 40% of 100 = 140

⇒ SP = 73.5% of 140

⇒ SP = (73.5 ÷ 100) × 140

⇒ SP = 0.735 × 140 = 102.9

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 102.9 − 100 = 2.9

⇒ Profit % = (2.9 ÷ 100) × 100 = 2.9%

**∴ The correct answer is 2.9%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Markup Percentage

It is the percentage by which the cost price is increased to set the marked price. Markup % = [(MP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100.

Discount and SP Relation

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price. SP = MP − Discount. If SP is given as a percentage of MP, then Discount % = 100% − (SP as % of MP).

Effective Profit Formula

Profit % can also be found using: Profit % = Markup % − Discount % − [(Markup % × Discount %) ÷ 100].</p

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. Diagonals BD and AC intersect each other at E. If ∠BEC = 128° and ∠ECD = 25°, then what is the measure of ∠BAC?

In ΔCED, ∠BEC is the exterior angle to vertex E (since AC and BD are straight lines).

Exterior ∠BEC = ∠EDC + ∠ECD (Sum of interior opposite angles)

128° = ∠EDC + 25° ⇒ ∠EDC = 103°.

Since angles subtended by the same arc BC are equal, ∠BAC = ∠BDC (or ∠EDC).

**∴ The correct answer is 103°.**

⇒ ∠CED = 180° − ∠BEC = 180° − 128° = 52°.

⇒ In ΔCED, the sum of internal angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠EDC + ∠ECD + ∠CED = 180°.

⇒ ∠EDC + 25° + 52° = 180°.

⇒ Note that ∠EDC is the same as ∠BDC.

⇒ By the property of circles, angles in the same segment (subtended by arc BC) are equal.

⇒ ∠BAC = ∠BDC = 103°.

**∴ The correct answer is 103°.**

Angles in the Same Segment

Angles subtended by the same arc at any point on the remaining part of the circle are equal.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

The sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is always 180° (∠A + ∠C = 180° and ∠B + ∠D = 180°).

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of its two interior opposite angles.

questions.question: When x is added to each of 9, 15, 21 and 31, the numbers so obtained are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between the numbers (3x - 2) and (5x + 4)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For numbers a, b, c, d to be in proportion after adding x: x = (ad − bc) / ((b + c) − (a + d))

Here, a = 9, b = 15, c = 21, d = 31 ⇒ x = (9 × 31 − 15 × 21) / ((15 + 21) − (9 + 31))

x = (279 − 315) / (36 − 40) = −36 / −4 = 9

Mean proportional between (3x − 2) and (5x + 4) = √((3 × 9 − 2) × (5 × 9 + 4)) = √(25 × 49) = 5 × 7 = 35

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: x is added to 9, 15, 21, and 31 such that (9+x), (15+x), (21+x), and (31+x) are in proportion.

Formula: If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1d56598684d60dca0d5af70192c85033c5a2e36461f83bf784bdd1fd3f24d6a.png] 

⇒ (9 + x) / (15 + x) = (21 + x) / (31 + x)

⇒ (9 + x)(31 + x) = (21 + x)(15 + x)

⇒ 279 + 31x + 9x + x² = 315 + 15x + 21x + x²

⇒ 279 + 40x = 315 + 36x

⇒ 40x − 36x = 315 − 279

⇒ 4x = 36 ⇒ x = 9

⇒ (3x − 2) = 3(9) − 2 = 25

⇒ (5x + 4) = 5(9) + 4 = 49

⇒ Mean proportional = √(25 × 49) = 5 × 7 = 35

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

**__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is the square root of their product: √(a × b).

Third Proportional

If a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a/b = b/c), then c is the third proportional to a and b, given by c = b²/a.

Fourth Proportional

In the proportion a:b :: c:d, d is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c, calculated as d = (b × c) / a.

Properties of Proportion

Product of extremes (a × d) = Product of means (b × c). Also, Componendo and Dividendo states if a/b = c/d, then (a+b)/(a−b) = (c+d)/(c−d).</p

⇒ Denominator = cosec R(sin R − cosec P) = (√10 / 3) × (3/√10 − √10) = (√10 / 3) × ((3 − 10)/√10) = −7 / 3

**∴ The correct answer is −2/7.**

**__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angle Identities

In a right-angled triangle, if ∠A + ∠B = 90°, then sin A = cos B, tan A = cot B, and sec A = cosec B.

Pythagorean Identities

Fundamental identities include sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

Trigonometric reciprocals are sin θ = 1/cosec θ, cos θ = 1/sec θ, and tan θ = 1/cot θ.</p

questions.question: Amit, after giving a 12% discount on the marked price, sells an article for Rs. 369.60. If he had not given any discount he would have gained 20%. Find the cost price of the item.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Marked Price (MP) = Selling Price ÷ (1 − Discount%) = 369.60 ÷ 0.88 = 420.

If no discount is given, MP becomes the new Selling Price.

Cost Price (CP) = MP ÷ (1 + Gain%) = 420 ÷ 1.20 = 350.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 350.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 369.60

Discount (d) = 12%

Gain (g) if no discount = 20%

**Formula Used:**

MP = [SP × 100] ÷ [100 − d]

CP = [MP × 100] ÷ [100 + g]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eecf6399787baa30f43f9c2be9395f2413e9fb645d374af6d84916cf71536003.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 88% of MP = 369.60

⇒ MP = (369.60 × 100) ÷ 88

⇒ MP = 4.2 × 100 = Rs. 420

⇒ If no discount is given, New SP = MP = Rs. 420

⇒ In this case, Profit = 20%

⇒ 120% of CP = 420

⇒ CP = (420 × 100) ÷ 120

⇒ CP = 420 ÷ 1.2 = Rs. 350

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 350.**

**__Additional Information__**

CP and MP Relation Formula

The ratio of Cost Price to Marked Price is given by CP/MP = (100 − Discount%) / (100 + Profit%).

Markup Percentage

Markup % = [(MP − CP) / CP] × 100. It represents how much the price is increased above the cost price.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the equivalent single discount is [a + b − (a × b / 100)]%.</p

questions.question: When positive numbers x, y and z are divided by 31, the remainders are 17, 24 and 27, respectively. When (4x - 2y + 3z) is divided by 31, the remainder will be:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Directly substitute the remainders into the given expression to find the net remainder.

Given: x → 17, y → 24, z → 27

Expression: 4(17) − 2(24) + 3(27)

Expression: 68 − 48 + 81 = 101

Final Remainder: 101 ÷ 31 = 3 with remainder 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: x = 31k₁ + 17, y = 31k₂ + 24, z = 31k₃ + 27

Formula: Remainder of sum/difference/product of numbers is equal to the sum/difference/product of their individual remainders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a31edd1f9bbdb18970b6ebcce3cc2eb863dd6c81c41810dc7dbac96ba5ddb76.png] 

⇒ Substitute individual remainders into the expression: 4x − 2y + 3z

⇒ Value = 4(17) − 2(24) + 3(27)

⇒ Value = 68 − 48 + 81

⇒ Value = 20 + 81 = 101

⇒ To find the remainder when 101 is divided by 31:

⇒ 101 = 31 × 3 + 8

⇒ Remainder = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

**__Additional Information__**

Remainder Theorem (Arithmetic)

The remainder of a polynomial or arithmetic expression f(x,y,z) divided by n is f(remₓ, remy, remz) mod n.

Additive and Multiplicative Properties

(A + B) mod n = (A mod n + B mod n) mod n and (A × B) mod n = (A mod n × B mod n) mod n.

Negative Remainder Concept

If a calculation results in a negative remainder −r, the positive equivalent is (divisor − r). For example, −2 mod 31 = 31 − 2 = 29.</p

questions.question: As observed from the top of a lighthouse, 120√3 m above the sea level, the angle of depression of a ship sailing towards it changes from 30° to 60°. The distance travelled by ship during the period of observation is:

The distance d between two points of observation for height h is: d = h(cot θ₁ − cot θ₂)

Given h = 120√3 m, θ₁ = 30° (far) and θ₂ = 60° (near).

d = 120√3 × (cot 30° − cot 60°)

d = 120√3 × (√3 − 1/√3) = 120√3 × (2/√3)

d = 120 × 2 = 240 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 240 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ 1/√3 = 120√3 / BD ⇒ BD = 120√3 × √3 = 120 × 3 = 360 m

⇒ Distance travelled by ship (CD) = BD − BC

⇒ CD = 360 − 120 = 240 m

**∴ The correct answer is 240 m.**

questions.question: A certain sum is lent at 4% p.a. for 3 years, 8% p.a. for the next 4 years, and 12% p.a. beyond 7 years. If for a period of 11 years, the simple interest obtained is Rs. 27,600, then the sum is (in Rs):

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate the total effective interest percentage for the entire period.

Total interest % = (4% × 3 years) + (8% × 4 years) + (12% × 4 years)

Total interest % = 12% + 32% + 48% = 92%

Given, 92% of Sum = ₹27,600

⇒ 1% of Sum = 27,600 ÷ 92 = 300

⇒ 100% (Sum) = 300 × 100 = 30,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹30,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Rate 2 (R₂) = 8%, Time 2 (T₂) = 4 years

Rate 3 (R₃) = 12%, Time 3 (T₃) = 11 − (3 + 4) = 4 years

Total Simple Interest (SI) = ₹27,600

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9aeaca928ee70a4a7d4b227d4261afa041a4d0e593c98cfbd935f4f9ff1fd49.png] 

Let the Sum be P.

⇒ Total SI = (P × R₁ × T₁)/100 + (P × R₂ × T₂)/100 + (P × R₃ × T₃)/100

⇒ 27600 = (P × 4 × 3)/100 + (P × 8 × 4)/100 + (P × 12 × 4)/100

⇒ 27600 = (12P + 32P + 48P) ÷ 100

⇒ 27600 = 92P ÷ 100

⇒ P = (27600 × 100) ÷ 92

⇒ P = 300 × 100

⇒ P = 30,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹30,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI). In percentage terms, A = 100% + (R × T)%.

Effective Interest Rate

When rates vary over different time periods, the net effective rate is the sum of (Rateᵢ × Timeᵢ) for each period.

Simple Interest Property

Simple interest is always calculated on the original principal throughout the entire duration of the loan.

questions.question: The areas of three adjacent faces of a cuboidal tank are 3 m², 12 m² and 16 m². the capacity of the tank, in litres, is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a cuboid (V) = √(Product of areas of three adjacent faces)

V = √(3 × 12 × 16) = √576 = 24 m³

Since 1 m³ = 1000 litres, Capacity = 24 × 1000 = 24000 litres.

**∴ The correct answer is 24000 litres.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of Face 1 (A₁) = 3 m²

Area of Face 2 (A₂) = 12 m²

Area of Face 3 (A₃) = 16 m²

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cuboid (V) = length (l) × breadth (b) × height (h)

Adjacent areas: A₁ = lb, A₂ = bh, A₃ = lh

Relationship: V = √(A₁ × A₂ × A₃)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a02b209cba11fbe4364dc5acea0c0919751d3d540b77f564554b379d8c2f2821.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the dimensions of the tank be l, b, and h.

⇒ lb = 3, bh = 12, lh = 16

⇒ (lb) × (bh) × (lh) = 3 × 12 × 16

⇒ l²b²h² = 576

⇒ (lbh)² = 576

⇒ lbh = √576 = 24 m³

⇒ Volume of the tank (V) = 24 m³

⇒ We know that 1 m³ = 1000 litres

⇒ Capacity in litres = 24 × 1000 = 24000 litres

**∴ The correct answer is 24000 litres.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid

The total surface area (TSA) is given by 2(lb + bh + hl), which is the sum of the areas of all six faces.

Length of Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed in a cuboidal room is the diagonal, calculated as √(l² + b² + h²).

Volume of a Cube

For a cube where all sides are equal (l = b = h = a), the volume is V = a³.

Capacity Conversion Units

1 m³ = 1000 litres | 1 litre = 1000 cm³ | 1000 litres = 1 kilolitre (kL).</p

questions.question: A train of length 287 m, running at 80 km/h, crosses another train moving in the opposite direction at 37 km/h in 18 seconds. What is the length of the other train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative Speed in opposite direction = 80 + 37 = 117 km/h

Relative Speed in m/s = 117 × 5/18 = 32.5 m/s

Total distance (sum of lengths) = Relative Speed × Time = 32.5 × 18 = 585 m

Length of the other train = 585 − 287 = 298 m

**∴ The correct answer is 298 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Length of first train (L₁) = 287 m

Speed of first train (S₁) = 80 km/h

Speed of second train (S₂) = 37 km/h

Time taken (t) = 18 s

Formula: (L₁ + L₂) = (S₁ + S₂) × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98e589bf71b49a5848bc68e1076bbd86685efa2d6f5b896624c34ba66118ec56.png] 

⇒ Relative speed = (80 + 37) km/h = 117 km/h

⇒ Relative speed in m/s = 117 × (5/18) m/s

⇒ Relative speed = 6.5 × 5 = 32.5 m/s

⇒ Total distance = L₁ + L₂ = 287 + L₂

⇒ 287 + L₂ = 32.5 × 18

⇒ 287 + L₂ = 585

⇒ L₂ = 585 − 287

⇒ L₂ = 298 m

**∴ The correct answer is 298 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ + S₂.

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = |S₁ − S₂|.

Speed Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Total Crossing Distance

When a train crosses another train or a bridge, the total distance covered is the sum of the lengths of both objects (L₁ + L₂).</p

questions.question: If (5)/(4{sqrt 2 )} + frac{{3 + 2sqrt 2 }}{{3 - 2sqrt 2 }} - frac{{3 - 2sqrt 2 }}{{3 + 2sqrt 2 }} = a + bsqrt 2 , then what is the value of (3a + 4b)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using identity: [(x + y)/(x − y)] − [(x − y)/(x + y)] = 4xy / (x² − y²)

Middle terms = [4 × 3 × 2√2] / [3² − (2√2)²] = 24√2 / (9 − 8) = 24√2

Expression = 5/(4√2) + 24√2 = 5√2/8 + 24√2 = (197/8)√2

Comparing with a + b√2 → a = 0, b = 197/8

Value of (3a + 4b) = 3(0) + 4(197/8) = 197/2 = 98½

**∴ The correct answer is 98½.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5/(4√2) + (3 + 2√2)/(3 − 2√2) − (3 − 2√2)/(3 + 2√2) = a + b√2

**Formula Used:**

Rationalization and Algebraic Identity: (x + y)² − (x − y)² = 4xy

**Calculations:**

⇒ Rationalizing first term: 5 / (4√2) = (5 × √2) / (4√2 × √2) = 5√2 / 8

⇒ Simplifying fractions: [(3 + 2√2)² − (3 − 2√2)²] / [(3 − 2√2)(3 + 2√2)]

⇒ Applying identity: [4 × 3 × 2√2] / [3² − (2√2)²]

⇒ [24√2] / [9 − 8] = 24√2

⇒ Total LHS = (5/8)√2 + 24√2 = (5/8 + 24)√2 = (197/8)√2

⇒ a + b√2 = 0 + (197/8)√2

⇒ On comparison: a = 0 and b = 197/8

⇒ Required value = 3a + 4b = 3(0) + 4(197/8)

⇒ 0 + 197/2 = 98.5 or 98½

**∴ The correct answer is 98½.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rationalization of Surds

To rationalize a denominator of the form (x − y), multiply both numerator and denominator by its conjugate (x + y) so that (x − y)(x + y) = x² − y².

Standard Algebraic Identities

(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab and (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²). These are frequently used to simplify symmetric surd fractions.

Comparing Coefficients

When an equation is in the form x + y√k = a + b√k, then x = a and y = b, provided x, y, a, b are rational and √k is irrational.</p

Water fraction in the resultant mixture = 8/21.

Using Alligation: x : y = (8/21 − 1/3) : (4/9 − 8/21).

x : y = (1/21) : (4/63) ⇒ 3/63 : 4/63 = 3 : 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of water and acid in A = 4 : 5

Ratio of water and acid in B = 1 : 2

Final ratio in mixture = 8 : 13

**Formula Used:**

Alligation Rule: (Quantity of A / Quantity of B) = (Fraction in B − Mean Fraction) / (Mean Fraction − Fraction in A)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/877d71c8865892d0bc37bbdd87af9832259c53eecc3d9cae2be4cb40d5c92bf9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Fraction of water in solution A = 4 / (4 + 5) = 4/9

⇒ Fraction of water in solution B = 1 / (1 + 2) = 1/3

⇒ Fraction of water in the final mixture = 8 / (8 + 13) = 8/21

⇒ x / y = (8/21 − 1/3) ÷ (4/9 − 8/21)

⇒ x / y = [(8 − 7) / 21] ÷ [(28 − 24) / 63]

⇒ x / y = (1/21) ÷ (4/63)

⇒ x / y = (1/21) × (63/4)

⇒ x / y = 3 / 4

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

It is used to find the ratio in which two ingredients at given prices/concentrations must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired price/concentration.

Component Consistency

When applying alligation, ensure all values represent the same component (either all acid fractions or all water fractions).

Mean Value Property

The mean value (mixture concentration) must always lie between the individual concentrations of the two components being mixed.</p

questions.question: The numerator of fraction is 3 more than the denominator. When 5 is added to the numerator and 2 is subtracted from the denominator, the fraction becomes 8/3, When the original fraction is divided by 5 (1)/(2), the fraction so obtained is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Assume Denominator = x, then Numerator = x + 3.

Condition: (x + 3 + 5) ÷ (x − 2) = 8/3 ⇒ (x + 8) / (x − 2) = 8/3.

By cross-multiplication: 3x + 24 = 8x − 16 ⇒ 5x = 40 ⇒ x = 8.

Original Fraction = (8 + 3) / 8 = 11/8.

New Fraction = (11/8) ÷ (11/2) = (11/8) × (2/11) = 1/4.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Numerator (N) = Denominator (D) + 3

Divisor = 5 1/2 = 11/2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8803a9dcf7bc7c5624910a5840fbe76fdf9aff957b61f39f8834e731f4ea86df.png] 

Formula used: Division of fractions (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) × (d/c)

⇒ Let the denominator be d.

⇒ Numerator = d + 3.

⇒ According to the question: (d + 3 + 5) / (d − 2) = 8/3

⇒ (d + 8) / (d − 2) = 8/3

⇒ 3 × (d + 8) = 8 × (d − 2)

⇒ 3d + 24 = 8d − 16

⇒ 8d − 3d = 24 + 16

⇒ 5d = 40

⇒ d = 8

⇒ Original fraction = (d + 3) / d = 11/8

⇒ Mixed fraction 5 1/2 = 11/2

⇒ Result = (11/8) ÷ (11/2) = (11/8) × (2/11)

⇒ Result = 2/8 = 1/4

**∴ The correct answer is 1/4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Proper and Improper Fractions

A proper fraction has a numerator smaller than the denominator (e.g., 1/4), while an improper fraction has a numerator equal to or greater than the denominator (e.g., 11/8).

Division of Fractions

To divide one fraction by another, multiply the first fraction by the reciprocal of the second fraction: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) × (d/c).

Mixed Numbers to Improper Fractions

To convert a mixed number x a/b, use the formula: (x × b + a) / b. For example, 5 1/2 = (5 × 2 + 1) / 2 = 11/2.</p

questions.question: In ΔABC, the bisector of ∠A intersects side BC at D. If AB = 12 cm, AC = 15 cm and BC = 18 cm, then the length of BD is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By Angle Bisector Theorem, the bisector of an angle divides the opposite side in the ratio of the other two sides.

Ratio of BD : DC = AB : AC = 12 : 15 = 4 : 5.

Total units = 4 + 5 = 9 units.

Given total length BC = 18 cm.

BD = (4 ÷ 9) × 18 = 8 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Triangle ABC where AB = 12 cm, AC = 15 cm, and BC = 18 cm.

AD is the internal bisector of ∠A meeting BC at D.

**Formula Used:**

Internal Angle Bisector Theorem: In ΔABC, if AD is the bisector of ∠A, then AB / AC = BD / DC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e04286ec6d0b94de2a3a43d426df4ac2bd97a414d338ad57af2e302ba102fde6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ BD / DC = AB / AC

⇒ BD / DC = 12 / 15

⇒ BD / DC = 4 / 5

⇒ Let BD = 4x and DC = 5x

⇒ BC = BD + DC = 4x + 5x = 9x

⇒ 18 = 9x

⇒ x = 18 ÷ 9 = 2

⇒ BD = 4x = 4 × 2 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Internal Angle Bisector Theorem

The internal bisector of an angle of a triangle divides the opposite side internally in the ratio of the sides containing the angle: BD/DC = AB/AC.

External Angle Bisector Theorem

The external bisector of an angle of a triangle divides the opposite side externally in the ratio of the sides containing the angle: BE/CE = AB/AC.

Length of the Angle Bisector

The length of the internal bisector AD can be calculated using the formula: AD² = AB × AC − BD × DC.

Incenter Property

The three internal angle bisectors of a triangle are concurrent at a point called the incenter, which is equidistant from all sides of the triangle.</p

questions.question: The lengths of two sides of a parallelogram are 3 cm and 10 cm. What is the sum of the squares of the diagonals of the parallelogram?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of squares of diagonals = 2 × (Sum of squares of adjacent sides)

Adjacent sides are 3 cm and 10 cm.

Sum = 2 × (3² + 10²)

Sum = 2 × (9 + 100) = 2 × 109 = 218 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 218 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sides of parallelogram a = 10 cm and b = 3 cm.

**Formula Used:** d₁² + d₂² = 2(a² + b²), where d₁ and d₂ are the diagonals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0027e088f660e09d9e162423de8980a0ea391061e715038f939b2d6e991d7a6a.png] 

⇒ Let the two diagonals be d₁ and d₂.

⇒ Using the property: d₁² + d₂² = 2(side₁² + side₂²)

⇒ d₁² + d₂² = 2(10² + 3²)

⇒ d₁² + d₂² = 2(100 + 9)

⇒ d₁² + d₂² = 2 × 109

⇒ d₁² + d₂² = 218 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 218 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Parallelogram

The area of a parallelogram is given by Base × Height or a × b × sin(θ), where θ is the angle between adjacent sides.

Diagonal Properties

The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other. They divide the parallelogram into two congruent triangles and four triangles of equal area.

Rhombus Special Case

For a rhombus, where all sides (a) are equal, the formula becomes d₁² + d₂² = 4a², and the diagonals bisect each other at 90°.</p

questions.question: The monthly incomes of A and B are in the ration 3 : 5 and the ratio of their savings is 2 : 3 If the income of B is equal to three times the savings of A, then what is the ratio of the expenditures of A and B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income ratio A : B = 3 : 5 and Savings ratio A : B = 2 : 3.

Condition: Income of B = 3 × Savings of A.

To align units, make Income of B (5 parts) equal to 3 × Savings of A (2 parts) ⇒ 5x = 6y ⇒ x/y = 6/5.

New Income A : B = (3×6) : (5×6) = 18 : 30.

New Savings A : B = (2×5) : (3×5) = 10 : 15.

Expenditure ratio = (18−10) : (30−15) = 8 : 15.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of monthly incomes (A : B) = 3 : 5

Ratio of savings (A : B) = 2 : 3

Condition: Income of B = 3 × Savings of A

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Income − Savings

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7fdf62a6a47784bc9c3bd2328bec8aac9d952aa2810aef2940c1a3724dee296.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Income of A = 3x and Income of B = 5x

⇒ Let Savings of A = 2y and Savings of B = 3y

⇒ According to the condition: 5x = 3 × 2y

⇒ 5x = 6y

⇒ x/y = 6/5

⇒ Let x = 6 and y = 5

⇒ Income of A = 3 × 6 = 18 units

⇒ Income of B = 5 × 6 = 30 units

⇒ Savings of A = 2 × 5 = 10 units

⇒ Savings of B = 3 × 5 = 15 units

⇒ Expenditure of A = 18 − 10 = 8 units

⇒ Expenditure of B = 30 − 15 = 15 units

⇒ Ratio of Expenditures = 8 : 15

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Fundamental

The basic accounting identity used in such problems is Income = Expenditure + Savings.

Ratio Balancing Technique

To compare two different ratios, we must find a common link (multiplier) based on the given constraint to bring them to the same unit scale.

Percentage Change in Expenditure

If income increases by a% and savings increase by b%, the new expenditure can be found using the same linear relationship: Iₙₑw − Sₙₑw = Eₙₑw.</p

questions.question: X and Y enter into a partnership with capital in the ratio 3 ∶ 5 After 5 months X adds 50% of his capital, while Y withdraws 60% of his capital. What is the share (in Rs. lakhs) of X in the annual profit of Rs. 6.84 lakhs?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Investment × Time for X = (3 × 5) + (4.5 × 7) = 46.5

Ratio of Investment × Time for Y = (5 × 5) + (2.0 × 7) = 39.0

Ratio of Profit X : Y = 46.5 : 39.0 = 31 : 26

Total units = 31 + 26 = 57 → ₹ 6.84 lakhs

X's share (31 units) = (6.84 ÷ 57) × 31 = 0.12 × 31 = ₹ 3.72 lakhs

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 3.72 lakhs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial capital ratio X : Y = 3 : 5

After 5 months: X adds 50% of 3 = 1.5 | Y withdraws 60% of 5 = 3

Total Time = 12 months | Total Profit = ₹ 6.84 lakhs

**Formula Used:**

Profit Ratio = (Investment₁ × Time₁) : (Investment₂ × Time₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76a1f8fb51959f2bc5531984d0a8232db1b7dfa5a664cc74c86820a94acc81a8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Investment of X for 1st 5 months = 3 units

⇒ Investment of X for next 7 months = 3 + 50% of 3 = 4.5 units

⇒ Investment of Y for 1st 5 months = 5 units

⇒ Investment of Y for next 7 months = 5 − 60% of 5 = 2 units

⇒ Total investment-period for X = (3 × 5) + (4.5 × 7) = 15 + 31.5 = 46.5

⇒ Total investment-period for Y = (5 × 5) + (2 × 7) = 25 + 14 = 39

⇒ Ratio of Profit X : Y = 46.5 : 39 = 31 : 26

⇒ X's share = [31 ÷ (31 + 26)] × 6.84

⇒ X's share = (31 ÷ 57) × 6.84 = 31 × 0.12 = ₹ 3.72 lakhs

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 3.72 lakhs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Rule of Partnership

Profit is always distributed in the ratio of the product of Capital and Time (P = C × T).

Variable Capital

When capital changes during the period, calculate equivalent monthly capital: ∑(Capitalᵢ × Timeᵢ).

Working vs Sleeping Partner

A working partner may receive an additional salary or commission from the gross profit before the remaining profit is divided.

questions.question: The average of three numbers a, b and c is 12 more than c. The average of a and b is 48. If d is 10 less than c, then the average of c and d is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Average of a and b = 48 → Sum (a + b) = 96.

Average of a, b, c = c + 12 → (96 + c) ÷ 3 = c + 12.

96 + c = 3c + 36 ⇒ 2c = 60 ⇒ c = 30.

Given d = c − 10 ⇒ d = 30 − 10 = 20.

Average of c and d = (30 + 20) ÷ 2 = 25.

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of a, b, c = c + 12

Average of a, b = 48

d = c − 10

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of values) ÷ (Number of values)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09f1dd589437f48f4cbda7ea151c416ab9fd605959430b2e47f87e2684f2778e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (a + b) ÷ 2 = 48

⇒ a + b = 48 × 2 = 96

⇒ (a + b + c) ÷ 3 = c + 12

⇒ 96 + c = 3(c + 12)

⇒ 96 + c = 3c + 36

⇒ 3c − c = 96 − 36

⇒ 2c = 60 ⇒ c = 30

⇒ d = c − 10 = 30 − 10 = 20

⇒ Average (c, d) = (30 + 20) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 50 ÷ 2 = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

**__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Average Properties

If every number in a set is increased or decreased by a constant k, the average also increases or decreases by k.

Weighted Average Formula

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Average of Consecutive Numbers

For a series in Arithmetic Progression (AP), the average is simply (First term + Last term) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: The radius and height of a right circular cone are in the ratio 3 : 4. If its curved surface area (in cm²) is 240 π, then its volume (in cm³) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of r : h : l = 3 : 4 : 5 (standard Pythagorean triplet).

Let r = 3x, h = 4x, and slant height l = 5x.

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = πrl = π × (3x) × (5x) = 15πx².

Given CSA = 240π ⇒ 15πx² = 240π ⇒ x² = 16 ⇒ x = 4.

Volume = (1/3) × π × (3x)² × (4x) = 12πx³ = 12π × (4)³ = 12π × 64 = 768π cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 768π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of radius (r) and height (h) = 3 : 4

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 240π cm²

**Formula Used:**

Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²)

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = πrl

Volume of Cone (V) = (1/3) × π × r² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab703eeea963d2a428a20610673334ffb3dcb918186bb53e67e6ab423b5f9c54.png] 

Let radius r = 3x and height h = 4x.

⇒ l = √((3x)² + (4x)²) = √(9x² + 16x²) = √(25x²) = 5x cm

⇒ CSA = π × r × l = π × 3x × 5x = 15πx²

⇒ 15πx² = 240π

⇒ x² = 240 ÷ 15 = 16

⇒ x = √16 = 4

⇒ Radius (r) = 3 × 4 = 12 cm

⇒ Height (h) = 4 × 4 = 16 cm

⇒ Volume (V) = (1/3) × π × (12)² × 16

⇒ Volume (V) = (1/3) × π × 144 × 16

⇒ Volume (V) = 48 × 16 × π = 768π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 768π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The TSA of a cone is the sum of its curved area and base area: TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

Pythagorean Relation in Cone

In any right circular cone, the height, radius, and slant height always satisfy l² = h² + r².

Volume Comparison

The volume of a cone is exactly 1/3 the volume of a cylinder with the same radius and height: V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3)V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ.

Frustum Volume

For a frustum of a cone with radii R and r and height h: Volume = (1/3)πh(R² + r² + Rr).</p

questions.question: Anuja owns 66 (2)/(3)\% of a property. If 30% of the property that she owns is worth Rs. 1,25,000, then 45% of the value (in Rs) of the property is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Anuja share = 66 ²/₃% = 2/3 of total property.

Given 30% of her share = 30% × 2/3 = 1/5 of total property.

1/5 unit = ₹1,25,000.

Total Property (1 unit) = ₹1,25,000 × 5 = ₹6,25,000.

Required 45% of property = 45% of 6,25,000 = ₹2,81,250.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,81,250.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Anuja ownership = 66 ²/₃% of the total property.

30% of Anuja ownership = ₹1,25,000.

**Formula Used:**

Value = Total × Ownership Fraction × Part Fraction

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fc9216af685d3a710568ff47776cb4b11cc6f4856ac2f6bfcc1ff6556c7fb32.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total value of the property be V.

⇒ Anuja share = 66 ²/₃% of V = (200/3)% × V = 2/3 × V.

⇒ 30% of Anuja share = 30/100 × (2/3 × V) = 1,25,000.

⇒ (3/10) × (2/3) × V = 1,25,000.

⇒ (1/5) × V = 1,25,000.

⇒ V = 1,25,000 × 5 = ₹6,25,000.

⇒ Required value = 45% of V = (45/100) × 6,25,000.

⇒ Required value = 45 × 6,250 = ₹2,81,250.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,81,250.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction conversion

Common fractions include 33 ¹/₃% = 1/3, 66 ²/₃% = 2/3, and 20% = 1/5. Using fractions simplifies multiplication in multi-step percentage problems.

Successive Percentage formula

When calculating a percentage of a percentage, the net percentage is (x/100) × (y/100) × 100. For example, 30% of 66 ²/₃% results in exactly 20% of the base value.

Unitary Method in Percentage

If a specific percentage 'p' of a quantity equals 'x', then 100% of the quantity equals (x ÷ p) × 100.

questions.question: The sum of radii spheres A and B is 14 cm, the radius of A being larger than that of B. The difference between their surface areas is 112 π. What is the ratio of the volumes of A and B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of radii (RA + RB) = 14 cm

Difference in Surface Areas: 4π(RA² − RB²) = 112π

RA² − RB² = 28 ⇒ (RA + RB)(RA − RB) = 28

14 × (RA − RB) = 28 ⇒ RA − RB = 2 cm

Solving RA+RB=14 and RA−RB=2 gives RA = 8 cm and RB = 6 cm

Ratio of Radii = 8 : 6 = 4 : 3 ⇒ Volume Ratio = 4³ : 3³ = 64 : 27

**∴ The correct answer is 64 : 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Radius of Sphere A = RA, Radius of Sphere B = RB (RA > RB)

Sum: RA + RB = 14 cm

Surface Area of Sphere = 4πr²

Volume of Sphere = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5987c294db0899ddb8942350f9734fb17285b33f8b47406826b07ec602767753.png] 

According to the question:

⇒ 4πRA² − 4πRB² = 112π

⇒ 4π(RA² − RB²) = 112π

⇒ RA² − RB² = 112 / 4 = 28

⇒ (RA + RB)(RA − RB) = 28

⇒ 14 × (RA − RB) = 28

⇒ RA − RB = 2

Adding the two equations:

⇒ (RA + RB) + (RA − RB) = 14 + 2

⇒ 2RA = 16 ⇒ RA = 8 cm

⇒ RB = 14 − 8 = 6 cm

Ratio of Volumes = [(4/3)πRA³] / [(4/3)πRB³]

⇒ Volume Ratio = (RA / RB)³

⇒ Volume Ratio = (8 / 6)³ = (4 / 3)³

⇒ Volume Ratio = 64 / 27

**∴ The correct answer is 64 : 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Spheres

The surface area (S) of a sphere is 4πr² and the volume (V) is (4/3)πr³.

Ratios of Similar 3D Figures

If the ratio of the radii of two spheres is a : b, then the ratio of their surface areas is a² : b² and the ratio of their volumes is a³ : b³.

Algebraic Identities in Geometry

The identity a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b) is frequently used to solve difference in area problems when the sum or difference of dimensions is known.</p

questions.question: The perimeters of ΔABC and ΔDEF are 43.2 cm and 28.8 cm, respectively, and ΔABC ~ ΔDEF. If DE = 12 cm, then the length of AB is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For similar triangles, the ratio of perimeters is equal to the ratio of corresponding sides.

Perimeter(ΔABC) ÷ Perimeter(ΔDEF) = AB ÷ DE

43.2 ÷ 28.8 = AB ÷ 12

1.5 = AB ÷ 12

AB = 1.5 × 12 = 18 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

questions.question: If 27(x + y)³ - 8(x - y)³ = (x + 5y)(Ax² + By² + Cxy), then what is the value of (A + B - C)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Apply the value substitution method by letting x = 1 and y = −1.

LHS = 27(1 − 1)³ − 8(1 − (−1))³ = 27(0) − 8(2)³ = −64.

RHS = (1 + 5(−1))(A(1)² + B(−1)² + C(1)(−1)) = −4(A + B − C).

Equating LHS and RHS: −64 = −4(A + B − C) ⇒ A + B − C = 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: 27(x + y)³ − 8(x − y)³ = (x + 5y)(Ax² + By² + Cxy)

Formula used: a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + b² + ab)

⇒ Let a = 3(x + y) and b = 2(x − y).

⇒ (a − b) = 3(x + y) − 2(x − y) = 3x + 3y − 2x + 2y = x + 5y.

⇒ a² = [3(x + y)]² = 9(x² + y² + 2xy) = 9x² + 9y² + 18xy.

⇒ b² = [2(x − y)]² = 4(x² + y² − 2xy) = 4x² + 4y² − 8xy.

⇒ ab = 3(x + y) × 2(x − y) = 6(x² − y²) = 6x² − 6y².

⇒ (a² + b² + ab) = (9x² + 4x² + 6x²) + (9y² + 4y² − 6y²) + (18xy − 8xy) = 19x² + 7y² + 10xy.

⇒ Comparing coefficients with Ax² + By² + Cxy: A = 19, B = 7, C = 10.

⇒ A + B − C = 19 + 7 − 10 = 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

**__Additional Information__**

Sum and Difference of Cubes

The fundamental identities are a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) and a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).

Algebraic Expansion

The cube of a binomial is (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3a²b + 3ab² and (a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3a²b + 3ab².

Identity Matching

When an identity holds for all values of x and y, you can substitute arbitrary values (like x = 1, y = 0 or y = −1) to find the values of unknown constants A, B, and C quickly.</p

questions.question: When 1062, 1134 and 1182 are divided by the greatest numbers x, remainder in each case is y. What is the value of (x - y)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When numbers leave the same remainder, the divisor x is the HCF of their differences.

Differences: (1134 − 1062) = 72 and (1182 − 1134) = 48.

x = HCF(72, 48) = 24.

y = Remainder when 1062 ÷ 24 = 6.

Value of (x − y) = 24 − 6 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers are 1062, 1134, and 1182. Divisor is x and common remainder is y.

**Formula Used:** If n₁, n₂, n₃ leave the same remainder y when divided by x, then x = HCF(|n₁ − n₂|, |n₂ − n₃|, |n₃ − n₁|).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06909deec16e4d249e96124bae12244f4fb6c63a604ea52be51e33fc02fc303.png] 

⇒ First difference = 1134 − 1062 = 72

⇒ Second difference = 1182 − 1134 = 48

⇒ Third difference = 1182 − 1062 = 120

⇒ x = HCF(72, 48, 120)

⇒ 72 = 24 × 3, 48 = 24 × 2, 120 = 24 × 5

⇒ x = 24

⇒ To find y, divide 1062 by 24: 1062 = (24 × 44) + 6

⇒ y = 6

⇒ Required value = x − y = 24 − 6 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF and Same Remainder Property

The largest number that divides several numbers leaving the same remainder is the HCF of the absolute differences between those numbers.

Case of Known Remainder

If the remainder R is given, then the greatest divisor is HCF of (Number₁ − R), (Number₂ − R), and (Number₃ − R).

Euclidean Algorithm

HCF(a, b) = HCF(b, a mod b). This is the fastest way to calculate the HCF of two large numbers manually.</p

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 43.2 minutes and 108 minutes, respectively. Pipe C can empty it at 3 litres/minute. When all the three pipes are opened together, they fill the tank in 54 minutes. The capacity (in litres) of the tank is:

Convert times to a common base: Pipe A = 43.2 = 216/5 min, Pipe B = 108 min, All = 54 min.

Take LCM of (216/5, 108, 54) = 216 units as total capacity.

Efficiencies: A = 5, B = 2, (A+B−C) = 4 units/min.

Efficiency of Pipe C = (Eff A + Eff B) − (Combined Eff) = (5 + 2) − 4 = 3 units/min.

Since Efficiency of C is 3 litres/min, then 3 units = 3 litres ⇒ 1 unit = 1 litre.

**∴ The correct answer is 216 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A = 43.2 minutes = 216/5 minutes

Time taken by Pipe B = 108 minutes

Time taken by (A + B − C) = 54 minutes

Rate of Pipe C = 3 litres/minute

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Capacity = Total Work units × (Actual rate ÷ Calculated efficiency)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe C = Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B − Efficiency of (A + B − C)

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe C = 5 + 2 − 4

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe C = 3 units/minute

⇒ According to the question, efficiency of C = 3 litres/minute
